SELECT p.id AS partner_id, p.code AS partner_code, p.name AS partner_name, g.last_date, g.last_price, g.min_date, g.min_price, g.max_date, g.max_price FROM ( SELECT x.partner_id, MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn_last = 1 THEN x.biz_date END) AS last_date, MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn_last = 1 THEN x.price END) AS last_price, MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn_min = 1 THEN x.biz_date END) AS min_date, MIN(x.price) AS min_price, MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn_max = 1 THEN x.biz_date END) AS max_date, MAX(x.price) AS max_price FROM ( SELECT d.partner_id, d.biz_date, COALESCE(i.gross_price, i.price) AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.partner_id ORDER BY d.biz_date DESC, d.id DESC, i.id DESC) AS rn_last, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.partner_id ORDER BY COALESCE(i.gross_price, i.price), d.biz_date, d.id) AS rn_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.partner_id ORDER BY COALESCE(i.gross_price, i.price) DESC, d.biz_date, d.id) AS rn_max FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.kind = #{kind} AND i.material_id = #{q.materialId} AND COALESCE(i.gross_price, i.price) > 0 ) x GROUP BY x.partner_id ) g
JOIN scm_customer p ON p.id = g.partner_id JOIN scm_supplier p ON p.id = g.partner_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND g.last_date >= #{q.start} AND g.last_date <= #{q.end} ORDER BY g.last_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit}
